DevopsProject.name: DevopsProject
DevopsProject.description: Represents a DevOps Center project. A project is the primary workspace where teams collaborate to manage changes for an app or customization. This object is the parent for all other DevOps Center objects, including pipelines, environments, and work items.

Description.description: A text description of the project's purpose or scope. DevOps Center uses this field only to display the description in the UI.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the project is currently active.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: The name of the DevOps Center project.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the project.
